description: This file implements an object pool for Kafka producers within Apache Spark, managing creation, caching, eviction, and shutdown of Kafka producer instances for efficient reuse in Spark SQL Kafka integration.

classes.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of KafkaProducer instances, handles creation, eviction, and thread-safe access.

classes.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool.CachedProducerEntry
classes.description: Metadata for cached KafkaProducer, tracks reference count and expiration time.

methods.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool.startEvictorThread
methods.description: Starts a scheduled thread to evict expired producers at fixed intervals.

methods.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool.acquire
methods.description: Returns a cached KafkaProducer for given parameters, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool.release
methods.description: Releases a KafkaProducer back to the pool, closing if not in use.

methods.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool.shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the producer pool and associated executor service.

methods.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool.reset
methods.description: Clears the cache and closes all producers.

methods.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool.eviction
methods.description: Evicts and closes expired KafkaProducers based on timeout.

methods.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool.createKafkaProducer
methods.description: Creates a new KafkaProducer instance with given parameters.

methods.name: InternalKafkaProducerPool.paramsToSeq
methods.description: Converts Kafka parameters map to a sorted sequence.
